verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party docs state that iPhone Mirroring "lets you see and use your iPhone right from your Mac," and the Mac Help guide says you can "view and control your iPhone right from your Mac desktop," which matches the story directly. Related Continuity features add supporting phone-from-desktop capabilities: placing calls from the Mac, Universal Clipboard, and Instant Hotspot. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of iPhone Mirroring, in-depth documentation of its requirements and limitations (e.g., device and OS compatibility, notifications, input fidelity).
